page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left, heading "Scena prima." centred, then the body in one column with list lines indented.

main_text.head: Scena prima.
main_text.p: SCena prior (quæ Mosen repræsentat apostatas Ju-dæos corripientem) tribus absolvitur actibus.

I. Actus primus ad apparatum spectat disceptationi causæ præmittendum, habetque se per modum proœ-mii. Hic Moses alloquium suum ad cælum & terram ut testes in causa validos dirigit, rogans ut dicendis abhinc assensum non denegent. Hos invitat
main_text.l: 1. Postulatum attentionis : quod ad captandam benevolentiam proponitur. verf. 1.
2. Confirmationem æquitatis postulati istius, argumentis desumptis
a. A sermonis proferendi efficacia & utilitate latissimâ. verf. 2.
b. Ab argumenti, quod exponere in animo habebat, pondere gravissimo. verf. 3. a.
1. Postulatum testimonii, quo cedant Deo nostro magnitudinem. verf. 3. b.
2. Expositio fidei orthodoxæ, quam explorandam & testimonio confirmandam exhibet. verf. 4.
3. Vindicatio ejusdem à scandalo objecto. verf. 5.
main_text.p: II. Actus secundus exhibet alloquium ad reos conversum, quos criminatur : ubi
main_text.l: A. Caput accusationis indicatur, scilicet prava retributio Jehovæ, per impactam illi corruptionem facta[?]. verf. 6. a.
B. Confirmatio criminis seu reatus subjicitur ; dum dignitas spretæ rupis probatur argumentis desumptis

page.notes: The long s is printed as a plain s; where the scan shows an f-like stroke (e.g. "absolvitur", "absfolvitur" in the scan) it was read as s. The word "facta" in the A-item is faint and doubtful, marked [?]. The "1. Ab" line at the foot is cut off by the end of the page and continues on the next page. Ink stains and show-through in the margins were ignored.
